s1.syndrome_frame: Chronic, severe, mechanical low back pain and mental depression with cutaneous and subcutaneous lesions and muscle contractures
salient_findings: Large and deep, irregularly shaped, cutaneous ulcer on the right forearm
Woody induration of skin on forearms and abdominal region
Bilateral contracture of deltoid, triceps, and biceps muscles
key_facts: 7-year history of severe, mechanical, low back pain
Long-standing mental depression
Current medications include duloxetine hydrochloride, clonazepam, oxcarbazepine, fentanyl, sulpiride, zopiclone, omeprazole magnesium, and baclofen
Self-administering subcutaneous injections of meperidine, 100 mg 4 times per day, for the past 3 years
Elevated serum creatinine kinase (192 U/L)
Normal complete blood cell count
Normal erythrocyte sedimentation rate
Normal antinuclear antibody
Normal rheumatoid factor
Lobular panniculitis, subcutaneous fat lobules with necrotic adipocytes and dense inflammatory infiltrates on histopathology
Severe fibrosis in deep dermis and subcutaneous septa on histopathology
No evidence of thrombosis or vasculitis on histopathology

Panniculitis associated with granulomatosis with polyangiitis
per_call: Subcutaneous fat necrosis of the newborn
Panniculitis associated with granulomatosis with polyangiitis

shortlist.label: Factitial panniculitis
shortlist.why_kept: Patient's history of self-administering subcutaneous injections of meperidine, which is consistent with factitial panniculitis

shortlist.label: Sclerosing lipogranuloma
shortlist.why_kept: Presence of lobular panniculitis, subcutaneous fat lobules with necrotic adipocytes, and dense inflammatory infiltrates on histopathology, which are characteristic of sclerosing lipogranuloma

shortlist.label: Panniculitis
shortlist.why_kept: Histopathology showing lobular panniculitis, subcutaneous fat lobules with necrotic adipocytes, and dense inflammatory infiltrates, which are consistent with panniculitis

shortlist.label: Lipodermatosclerosis
shortlist.why_kept: Presence of woody induration of skin on both forearms and abdominal region, which is consistent with lipodermatosclerosis

shortlist.label: Eosinophilic fasciitis
shortlist.why_kept: Presence of severe fibrosis in deep dermis and subcutaneous septa on histopathology, which is consistent with eosinophilic fasciitis

raw.rationale: The patient's history of self-administering subcutaneous injections of meperidine, the presence of lobular panniculitis, and severe fibrosis in deep dermis and subcutaneous septa on histopathology, along with the absence of polarizable foreign material, are consistent with sclerosing lipogranuloma, a condition often associated with the injection of foreign substances into the skin

rejected.label: Factitial panniculitis
rejected.why: While factitial panniculitis involves self-inflicted injury, the specific findings of lobular panniculitis and severe fibrosis point more towards sclerosing lipogranuloma

rejected.label: Panniculitis
rejected.why: Too broad, as panniculitis refers to a group of conditions that involve inflammation of the subcutaneous fat, and the patient's presentation suggests a more specific diagnosis

rejected.label: Lipodermatosclerosis
rejected.why: Typically associated with chronic venous insufficiency, which is not indicated in the patient's history

rejected.label: Eosinophilic fasciitis
rejected.why: Characterized by inflammation of the fascia, which is not the primary finding in this patient's histopathology
